page.layout: One printed page. Woodcut ornament at top; title block centred in capitals and roman; a large woodcut initial S opens the text at left; running text in two lines of paragraph beside the initial and below. Top right: a manuscript library mark (not transcribed). Signature "ij" at the foot right with an asterisk mark.

main_text.l: hanc omneis etiam sine oculis agnoscunt &
laudant. Ac sanè tanti est, vt si omnia,
quæ vocantur externa, in vna lance ponerentur,
in altera: hæc sola reliquis præponderaret
omnibus. De vera loquor, quæ à leuium

page.notes: The initial S is a large woodcut initial, joined to the word "PLENDIDISSIMVS" as printed ("SPLENDIDISSIMVS" with the woodcut S). Doubtful readings: "Vvharto-" and "Vvhartone" are as printed (V-with-v forms). The catchword "De" is taken from the final word line of the page as it appears at the foot; it is doubtful. The words "sola" and "reliquis" in the penultimate line are partly obscured by underlining/ink and are read with caution. A library ink mark "LIBIE" and "12mo" at top right are not transcribed.
